items: Left panel is a projected cone with S at its apex near (108,75), A at a front-left rim point near (51,275), and an O-like center glyph beside the interior axis foot near (116,250).
S ink lies above apex; A ink lies below/left of its rim point; O-like ink lies right of the axis foot.
No B or C labels are visible on the cone silhouette endpoints.
A lower panel caption is an a-like glyph followed by a right parenthesis near (127,345); Latin a versus Cyrillic a cannot be established from pixels.
Labels are black, heavy, slanted serif-like ink; exact source codepoints, font, and emphasis remain uncertain.
A solid left silhouette generator connects apex to the left rim endpoint near (22,247).
A solid right silhouette generator connects apex to the right rim endpoint near (210,246).
An additional solid generator SA runs inside the left silhouette and terminates at A on the front rim.
A near-vertical dashed SO axis descends from S to the base center.
A dashed OA segment runs down/left from the center to A.
The full projected elliptical base has a solid front/lower arc through A and a dashed rear/upper arc.
The rear arc passes above the center near y=210; the front reaches near y=284.
SA and SO cross the rear rim without additional named points or explicit point dots.
S, O, and A are distinct; A is on the front rim, not the left silhouette endpoint.
There is no visible radius to the right or left silhouette endpoint, no numeric measure, and no right-angle marker.
Right panel is a separate flattened fan/sector outline, not attached to the left cone by any line or arrow.
S labels the sector apex near (452,54), with ink above.
A labels the left sector arc endpoint near (265,101), with ink left of that endpoint.
A with a lowered small 1 labels the right sector arc endpoint near (638,78), with ink right of that endpoint.
Two solid radial boundaries run S-A down/left and S-A1 down/right.
One continuous solid outer arc runs from A around the bottom near (450,245) to A1.
The source has unequal apparent radial lengths and a slightly asymmetric hand-drawn curve; it does not supply an angle, radius length, arc length, or exact circularity metric.
No internal arc, dashed line, base circle, center/radius guide, numeric value, equality tick, or answer annotation is visible in this sector.
A lower panel caption is a Cyrillic be-like glyph followed by a right parenthesis near (474,326).
A small isolated ink fleck near (695,148) and scan specks are not labeled geometric objects.

panelsAndGivens.netAttachment: no base circle or attachment is visible

uncertainties: O versus zero, source Latin/Cyrillic lookalikes, exact font, and panel-caption codepoints are not established by source pixels alone.
The right-endpoint subscript visually resembles 1; later edition text must bind its mathematical identity.
The fan's rough radial lengths and outer curve are not exact source metric givens; a mathematically regular sector would be an author-chosen regularization.
No direct relationship between cone projected distances and true sector radii is asserted from 2D pixel lengths.
Named points, lines, solid/dashed rim ownership, and panel separation are clear despite rough ink.
